name: html-inline-svg-css-limit-only-intrinsic-size
description: An inline SVG sized only by CSS limits (max-height) keeps its viewBox size on the materialized SVG asset, so the native image does not collapse to 0x0 inside a shrink-to-fit figure.

source_reference.notes: Distilled from gameover.ai (r12): a centered logo <svg style="max-height:50vh" viewBox="0 0 260 511.59"> with no width/height rendered 0x0 because the standalone SVG asset had no natural size.

legacy_comparison.reason: This upstream primitive fixture has no downstream legacy comparison.
